audience.text: C++ developers building cross-platform applications that need to generate or manipulate PowerPoint presentations without requiring Microsoft PowerPoint or COM interop.

capabilities.text: Create new presentations with a default blank slide or load existing .pptx files, then save to Office Open XML formats using Presentation and SaveFormat.
capabilities.title: Create and edit presentations

capabilities.text: Add, remove, and clone slides via SlideCollection; insert AutoShapes, Tables, Connectors, and PictureFrames via ShapeCollection methods.
capabilities.title: Manage slides and shapes

capabilities.text: Apply character-level formatting via PortionFormat, paragraph formatting via ParagraphFormat, and shape fills, outlines, shadows, 3D effects via respective format classes.
capabilities.title: Format text and shapes

capabilities.text: Add per-slide speaker notes via NotesSlideManager and add comments with authors, positions, timestamps, and replies via CommentAuthorCollection and CommentCollection.
capabilities.title: Add speaker notes and comments

capabilities.text: Embed images from in-memory byte buffers via ImageCollection and set core, application, and custom document properties via DocumentProperties.
capabilities.title: Embed images and manage document properties

capabilities.text: Save presentations to six Office Open XML formats: PPTX, PPTM, PPSX, PPSM, POTX, and POTM.
capabilities.title: Export to multiple formats

capabilities.text: Unknown XML parts encountered during load are preserved verbatim on save, ensuring round-trip integrity for unmodeled content.
capabilities.title: Preserve unknown XML parts

capabilities.text: Integrate via CMake FetchContent or install via CMake package; requires C++20 and CMake 3.20+.
capabilities.title: Cross-platform CMake integration

limitations.text: Save() only accepts file paths; saving to streams is unsupported.
Add_image() only accepts in-memory byte buffers; loading images from paths or streams is unsupported.
Add_clone() on slides loses text content of shapes; the clone copies geometry but not text frames.
Add_clone() on masters does not persist to the saved package; slide master references are not written.
Save() throws std::invalid_argument for non-Office Open XML formats (PDF, HTML, ODP, images, etc.); only six PPTX-family formats are supported.
pugixml is exposed in the public interface; consumers must link against pugixml headers and library.

problems_solved.text: Enables programmatic PowerPoint creation and editing in C++ without external dependencies like Microsoft Office, COM, or proprietary runtimes.
Supports CMake-based builds with automatic dependency fetching via FetchContent, simplifying integration into existing C++ projects.
Provides a stable, versioned static library with prebuilt Windows NuGet packages for MSVC, reducing build complexity on Windows.

product_summary.text: Aspose.Slides FOSS for C++ is a free, open-source C++20 library for creating, reading, and editing PowerPoint presentations, distributed under the MIT License.

uncertainties: Whether the library supports saving to SVG or other non-PPTX-family formats beyond the documented SaveFormat enum.
Whether the library supports VBA macro injection or editing.
Whether digital signatures are supported in any form.
Whether animations or slide transitions are partially supported beyond the documented absence.
Whether the library supports slide backgrounds or themes beyond what is documented.
Whether placeholder geometry inheritance is fully modeled for all layout scenarios.
Whether the conformance test suite covers all edge cases for unknown XML parts preservation.
Whether the NuGet package supports ARM64 Windows beyond x64 and Win32.

workflows.name: Create presentation with comments
workflows.text: Instantiate a Presentation, add a comment author, insert a comment with position and timestamp, link a reply using set_parent_comment, and save to PPTX.

workflows.name: Set document properties
workflows.text: Create a Presentation, set title, author, and custom properties via document_properties(), then save to PPTX.

workflows.name: Build and test
workflows.text: Build the library with CMake 3.20+, fetch dependencies (pugixml, miniz, googletest), run unit, integration, and conformance tests, and validate output packages.
